title: Dispensing Fee on Self-Administered Drugs by Account Class and Campus — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Pharmacy cost term.** A dispensing fee, the cost Riverbend gives up in dispensing the drugs, is added to the value of self-administered drugs (codes J8499, J8540 and J7613 under revenue code 0637) on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing):

| Account class and campus | Dispensing fee |
|---|---|
| Observation Stay Account at a hospital campus (Riverbend Regional Medical Center - Appleton or Riverbend Lakeshore Hospital - Neenah) | 0.50 USD for each line of the three drug codes |
| Emergency Department Visit Account at such a campus | one 1.00 USD fee for the visit |
| otherwise | 0.00 |

Example (hypothetical): 6 lines of the three drug codes on an Observation Stay Account at Appleton → 3.00; on an Emergency Department Visit Account at Appleton → 1.00 for the visit; on either account class at Riverbend Community Hospital - Chilton → 0.00.
